# Compass Index Management — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Compass Index Management. Run status: COMPLETED.

## How it works

- [statement] A zero usage count alone does not justify removal: recent restarts and infrequent critical queries can make a needed index appear unused. Observe a representative application cycle. (high confidence) — https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md, https://www.mydbops.com/blog/mongodb-index-usage-analysis
- [statement] COMPASS-7823 reports that Compass 1.42.3 on macOS 14.2.1 removed JSON-key quotes when formatting partialFilterExpression, then rejected its own output. This is historical version-specific evidence, not proof that current versions remain affected. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/COMPASS-7823

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The default _id index cannot be dropped independently of its collection. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/drop-index.md · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The Compass 1.51.0 release notes list shell-syntax index creation under COMPASS-9352; older screenshots and form instructions may differ from that interface. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-25) — https://github.com/mongodb-js/compass/releases

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Compass exposes collection indexes in an Indexes tab with names, keys, types, sizes, usage counts, and properties. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view, https://www.mydbops.com/blog/mongodb-index-usage-analysis, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/
- [statement] The creation dialog supports multiple fields with ascending or descending order for compound indexes, plus optional names, partial filters, and collation. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/ · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md
- [statement] Compass Usage reflects lookup activity on the connected node since creation or server restart; inspect $indexStats on each node for broader coverage. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/ · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79119345/why-doesnt-mongooses-findbyid-method-increment-id-index-usage-in-mongo
- [statement] Hide an index before dropping it to assess query impact. Compass provides hide/unhide controls and a Hidden property badge. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/drop-index.md
- [statement] Dropping through Compass requires the trash icon and a confirmation dialog in which the operator enters the index name. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes/ · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/indexes.md, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view
- [statement] A June–July 2025 community thread reports 'Usage data unavailable' in Compass. A respondent recommends checking privileges for $indexStats; the thread does not demonstrate a confirmed fix for the original reporter. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/index-usage-data-unavailable-in-compass/323476
- [statement] Shell inspection complements Compass: collection stats expose indexSizes, while $indexStats exposes usage counters that reset after server restart. (medium confidence) — https://phauer.com/2019/mongodb-development-tools-snippets/ · keywords: Compass Index Management · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-how-to-manage-indexes-with-mongodb-compass/view, https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/
